---
description: "Review code changes for missing or insufficient test coverage."
name: "Review Test Completeness"
argument-hint: "Files, components, or diff to review"
---
Review whether test expectations are satisfied.

Check for:
- Missing unit tests for behavior changes
- Missing integration tests for API/pipeline changes
- Missing mapping tests for significant transforms
- Lack of success/failure/edge coverage

Output findings with severity and required follow-up tests.
